name: Central New Hampshire Snowmobile Club
tagline: Maintaining nearly 100 miles of trails in Campton, Ellsworth, and Thornton, NH
description: The Central New Hampshire Snowmobile Club trails cover the southern tip of the White Mountain National Forest. Access trails from Interstate 93 Exits 28, 29, and 30, just north of Plymouth, New Hampshire.
trailReportSchedule: Trail conditions are posted every Thursday during riding season.
